$Comment: Kill XP for Hallow's Eve's creatures, on a server running MMO Skill Tree. Only that mod reads
this folder, so without it the file is never loaded.
A pattern is matched as a substring of the creature's role id and the longest match wins, so each
row names one role by its whole id and reaches only that role, ahead of the shorter patterns MMO
Skill Tree ships (Ghoul, Skeleton, Wraith) the others would otherwise fall to; the Jack Archer's
row is longer than the Jack Skeleton's, whose id its own begins with, the Pumpkin Fiend
Hatchling's (the fiend the Headless Horseman's pumpkins hatch) is longer than the wild fiend's,
and the hard ride's Hatchling's (_HM) is longer than the normal Hatchling's.
Without their rows a Lost Soul or a Pumpkin Fiend would fall to the plain fallback. The value is the
XP a kill is worth before any boost: a Jack Skeleton or a Jack Archer is worth twice the plain
skeleton of its kind, and a Pumpkin Fiend, a weak creature that comes in packs, twice a minor enemy.
The Hatchlings are tougher than the wild fiend and pay more: the normal ride's, with twice its health,
about half as much again, and the hard ride's, with more than four times its health, a little over
Name: Mmo_Hallows_Eve
